items.name: NVIDIA
items.headline: CEO Huang resigns; CFO Kress named interim CEO
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: on Nov. 11 the Board accepted Jen-Hsun Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director, effective immediately.
items.thesis: The Board appointed CFO Colette M. Kress, age 59, interim CEO while it searches for a successor, and named Harvey C. Jones, age 73, Chair. Kress continues as CFO.

items.name: Meta Platforms
items.headline: Completes €9.0B six-tranche euro senior notes offering
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 8.01: on Nov. 12 Meta completed its offering of euro senior notes due 2031, 2033, 2035, 2038, 2044 and 2065.
items.thesis: Coupons range from 4.300% on the 2031 notes to 6.400% on the 2065 notes; tranche sizes sum to €9.0 billion. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration.

items.name: Charles Schwab
items.headline: Issues $3.0B of senior and floating-rate notes in three tranches
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 8.01: on Nov. 12 Schwab issued $300M floating rate notes due 2030, $1.3B 5.334% notes due 2030 and $1.4B 5.732% notes due 2034.
items.thesis: Net proceeds were approximately $2,982 million after underwriting discounts and estimated expenses, per the filing.

items.name: Marvell Technology
items.headline: Expands board from seven to ten directors
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: on Nov. 11 the Board approved the increase and appointed Donna C. Morris, Douglas R. Bettinger and Sasan K. Goodarzi, effective Nov. 12.
items.thesis: All three are independent directors and will stand for election at the 2027 annual meeting; Bettinger joins the Audit Committee and qualifies as an audit committee financial expert.

items.name: Target
items.headline: Elects Sally Grimes to board effective Dec. 1
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 5.02: on Nov. 11 the Board elected Sally Grimes, age 55, a director effective Dec. 1, 2026.
items.thesis: Grimes, formerly CEO North America at Diageo, will serve on the Audit & Risk and Infrastructure & Finance committees. The filing reports no related-person transactions.

items.name: Emerson Electric
items.headline: Prices €750M 4.000% notes due 2032
items.catalyst: Form 8-K, Item 8.01: pricing agreement dated Nov. 10 for €750,000,000 of 4.000% Notes due 2032.
items.thesis: The notes were sold at an issue price of 99.264% of principal, offered to the public at 99.639%; closing was expected Nov. 13, 2026.
